# Barrio Energy

> Barrio Energy (Houston) develops and leases powered industrial sites in Texas for data centers, bitcoin mining and battery storage. It also runs the Barrio Grid Connector, a public MCP server and REST API with Texas power grid siting data.

## Barrio Grid Connector

Texas grid siting data for agents: nearest substations, transmission lines, likely serving utility, jurisdiction (city limits, ETJ, school and groundwater districts), gas pipelines, industrial neighbors and air permits, ERCOT generation and battery queue, planned transmission upgrades, ERCOT nodal, real-time and ancillary prices, and parcels near high-voltage substations (powered land).

Accounts, keys, Pro and the map: https://map.barrioenergy.com

- MCP server (streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 sign-in, free account): https://grid.barrioenergy.com/mcp
- REST base: https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/ (tool list and schemas: https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/tools)
- Human docs: https://barrioenergy.com/grid
- Agent skill file: https://barrioenergy.com/grid/skill.md

### Tools

- grid_context: county, likely utility, 3 nearest substations, transmission lines, ERCOT queue projects and planned upgrades around a Texas site, plus railroads (nearest lines with owner and type; crossings and same_side_of_rail between the site and its nearest substation, or a point passed as to_lat/to_lng).
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/grid_context?address=Edna,%20TX&radius_mi=5"
- nearest_substation: closest substations with voltage, owner and distance in miles. Also returns planned, unbuilt substations nearby (built:false, status, docket, expected date, pin confidence and the docket's location caveat) and warns when a planned and a built station share a name.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/nearest_substation?lat=28.9&lng=-96.6&min_kv=138&limit=5"
- find_powered_land: parcels within a set distance of a qualifying substation, by county or point and radius. owner_type=company|individual|trust_estate|public|private filters landowners. group_by_owner=true ranks owners by total acres near the substation (min_total_acres, min_parcel_acres). Enterprise; Free and Pro get parcel and owner counts.
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRID_KEY" "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/find_powered_land?county=Jackson&group_by_owner=true&min_total_acres=200&max_sub_mi=1"
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/find_powered_land?county=Jackson&min_acres=50&max_sub_mi=1&min_kv=138"
- ercot_queue: ERCOT GIS report generation and storage projects near a site, in a county, or at a POI substation: INR, project name, fuel, tech, MW, county, zone, POI substation, study phase, COD, entity. Summary with mw_by_fuel and mw_by_stage. Filter by fuel (SOL, WIN, GAS, etc.). Free: fuel, county, zone, distance_mi. Pro: full project details.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/ercot_queue?county=Live%20Oak"
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/ercot_queue?poi=Hillje&fuel=SOL"
- battery_queue: ERCOT GIS battery projects by site, county or POI substation: developer, MW, stage (screening, fis_started, fis_complete, ia_signed, energized), COD; totals.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/battery_queue?county=Jackson&status=ia"
- power_plants: EIA-860M operating and planned plants and batteries near a site or in a county: operator, technology, MW, storage MWh and duration, operating year, retirements. Filter kind=storage for operating battery saturation.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/power_plants?county=Brazoria&kind=storage"
- parcel_owner: who owns land at an address, around a named substation (e.g. Hillje) or by property ID: property ID, acres, situs address, legal description, appraisal values. Owner name and mailing address on Enterprise. Each parcel carries owner_class (university_lands, state, federal, county, city, school_district, special_district, railroad, utility, company, individual, trust_estate), undivided_interest when several owners share one property ID, city_limits_per_cad from the ICL/OCL legal token, and value_status (not_published_by_county means zeros are missing data, not a $0 parcel).
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRID_KEY" "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/parcel_owner?substation=Hillje&radius_mi=1&min_acres=20"
- jurisdiction: county, inside city limits, ETJ estimate, nearest city, school district, groundwater district, load zone, likely utility, Qualified Opportunity Zone now (QOZ 1.0, through 2026) and from 2027 (QOZ 2.0, nominated pending Treasury certification). Free: in a zone yes/no; Pro: tract, county, rural flag, dates. cad_city_limits compares the appraisal roll's ICL/OCL legal token for the parcel at the point with the boundary layer and warns when they disagree.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/jurisdiction?address=Edna,%20TX"
- pipelines_near: RRC-permitted gas pipelines near a site: operator, system, nominal diameter, interstate or intrastate, distance; nearest 12-inch-plus and interstate; within 15 mi: trunklines, compressor stations (HP), processing plants (MMcf/d), EIA capacity projects by those operators.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/pipelines_near?address=Edna,%20TX&radius_mi=5"
- fiber_near: fiber near a site: routes by provider with distance and path basis (gis_published = provider GIS, carrier_on_corridor = highway corridor, path inferred), nearest carrier hotels/colo/data centers, FCC fiber-to-premises providers. Pro adds fiber count, placement, use, route and facility names, FTTP locations and speeds.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/fiber_near?address=Goliad,%20TX&radius_mi=10"
- industrial_neighbors: TCEQ emissions-inventory sites and recent air permit applications (data-center flag) near a site.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/industrial_neighbors?address=Victoria,%20TX&radius_mi=5"
- site_screen (Enterprise; Free and Pro get the score, flag counts, county, load zone and nearest substation): one-call screen for use=data_center|battery|generation|industrial: flags (including railroad crossings between the site and its substation; to_lat/to_lng tests another point) plus a 0-100 score with stated weights, and the parcel at the point with its owner and that owner's holdings within 5 miles.
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRID_KEY" "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/site_screen?address=Edna,%20TX&use=battery"
- search_grid: find anything by name (substation, owner company, ERCOT code, project, docket, battery developer/POI/INR, permit company or number, node, city, county), with coordinates.
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRID_KEY" "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/search_grid?query=Lolita"
- substation_detail: one substation by name: kV, owner, lines, batteries at its POI, generation_queue_at_poi (total projects, mw_total, projects by fuel/mw/study_phase), queue, prices, station_class (inferred: distribution, transmission, switching, generation_tie, customer_owned, with evidence), likely_utility_basis (owner vote among the 7 nearest stations, with disagrees_with_station_owner and a warning); planned upgrades on Pro, landowners on Enterprise.
- grid_projects (Pro): planned new substations, approved lines and upgrades by location, county or utility, with status, date, cost, docket, sources.
- air_permits (Pro): TCEQ generation and data-center permits by location, county, status, date, fuel or company.
- whats_new (Pro): battery milestones, queue entries, permits and new grid projects near a site or in a county over the last N days.
- large_loads: large loads in a county or around a site (data centers, crypto, LNG, industrial): announced data center campuses with coordinates and a 75 MW flag, campuses within 25 miles across county lines, load-driven transmission projects from ERCOT TPIT, data-center air permits, local news, Grid Report mentions, load zone and utility; Pro adds the local sentiment score. list_counties=true ranks all counties and lists those with none. ERCOT does not publish the large load queue by county; this is the public county-level evidence.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/large_loads?county=Hall"
- data_centers: Texas data center projects (hyperscale, AI campus, colocation, HPC conversion, powered land) near a site or in a county: locations free; names, companies (developer, end user, parents), status and dates, MW, acres, capex, utility and substation, tax abatements, local opposition, confidence and sources on Pro. 364 projects on 274 campuses, 101 counties; MW totals count campuses only. Barrio Energy research from utility and PUCT filings, county and city records, abatement agreements, TDLR and TCEQ records and news.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/data_centers?county=Hood"
- company_footprint (Pro): companies ranked by number of Texas data center projects (min_projects, default 3) with total stated MW, counties and how many are operating or under construction; or every project for one company.
- local_sentiment (Pro): how a Texas county or city treats data centers, by name or at an address. Score from official actions since September 2024 (abatement or JETI approved +3, zoning approved +2, development/EDC agreement or reinvestment zone +2, permit or water agreement +1, moratorium or zoning ban -4, zoning denied -3, resolution opposing data centers -2, project withdrawn after opposition -2, resolution asking the Legislature for authority -1; abatement denials, no-abatement policies and zoning rules that allow data centers with conditions 0), each project counted once per jurisdiction, 12-month half-life, dropped after 24 months. Community opposition and lawsuits listed, not scored. Counties and cities scored separately.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/local_sentiment?county=Bell"
- data_center_news: local and trade news on Texas data center projects near a site or in a county: headline, outlet, date, link and topics; summaries and linked projects on Pro.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/data_center_news?county=Hood"
- node_prices: ERCOT day-ahead prices (hourly, USD/MWh) for the load zone at a site, nearest resource nodes and hubs with 7-day stats, or one settlement point's series.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/node_prices?address=Edna,%20TX"
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/node_prices?settlement_point=HB_HOUSTON&days=30"
- volatile_nodes: rank nodes for storage and solar: tb4 (default), tb2, stdev, cv, range, spikes, negative, evening, solar, solar_ratio, basis, avg, rt_tb4, rt_spikes, dart. Each node carries queued_storage_10mi.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/volatile_nodes?metric=tb4&load_zone=LZ_WEST&limit=10"
- ancillary_prices: ERCOT DAM ancillary service clearing prices (RegUp, RegDown, RRS, ECRS, Non-Spin), battery AS stack, monthly history back to 2024. System-wide.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/ancillary_prices?days=30&monthly_history=true"
- grid_news: latest or keyword-matched articles from The Grid Report (Texas grid, ERCOT, Batch Zero, large loads, transmission). Full text with article_id. Unmetered.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/grid_news?query=batch%20zero&limit=5"
- my_projects: the signed-in user's places from the map in three lists (Properties, Prospects, Saved places): sites, tracts and routes imported from KMZ/KML/GeoJSON, points saved on the map, and lists synced from the user's own systems. Lists them (list= to narrow), or reads one project (name, type, point, acres, folder, note, details); screen=true (Pro) runs site_screen on up to 25 features and ranks them. MCP only; needs an account-linked connection. Private to the user.
- save_place: saves an address or lat/lng to the user's Saved places with a name and note, only when the user asks. Returns a map link. Free 10 places, Pro 500. Unmetered.
- upgrade_to_pro: Pro checkout link (Stripe, accepts Link), optional email prefill. Only buy with the user's approval.
  curl "https://grid.barrioenergy.com/v1/upgrade_to_pro?email=you@example.com"

Locations: a street address, a Texas city or county name, or lat + lng. Texas only. Distances in miles. Answers with a location include map_url, a link to that spot on the web map. The link is signed in for the caller's account (encrypted token, 7 days, 25 opens, map only); free accounts see base layers, Pro sees every layer: give it to the user as a clickable link, do not post it publicly.

### Pricing

- Every call needs an account. MCP clients sign in with OAuth (email and 6 digit code); REST sends Authorization: Bearer grid_... from https://map.barrioenergy.com/account.
- Free: 20 calls a day and 100 a month (then 5 a day until the 1st), 7 days of prices, 10 ranked nodes, 10 parcels within 5 miles, first 5 queue projects with full totals. Web map with substations, lines, city limits and node prices, 10 site clicks a day.
- Pro: 499 USD a month (first month 249 USD for new subscribers) or 4,990 USD a year, 5,000 calls a month, 200 parcels per search, 120 days of prices, the site_screen score, and the web map layers for approved lines, battery queue, air permits, pipelines, parcels, data centers and local sentiment. Header: Authorization: Bearer grid_... Subscribe: https://map.barrioenergy.com/pricing
- Enterprise: Parcel-level siting: parcel searches near substations, landowner names and mailing addresses, owners ranked by acres, site_screen flags and weights, Dub+ (the Land Desk), the New substations and Substation upgrades map layers, and custom limits. Approved account by account. ivan@barrioenergy.com

### Data

HIFLD substations and transmission (owners enriched by Barrio), ERCOT GIS generation and battery queue, ERCOT public API prices, Barrio research on planned ERCOT/PUCT transmission projects, TxDOT/StratMap/Census/TWDB boundaries, RRC pipeline permits, HIFLD/ORNL compressor stations, HIFLD/EIA-757 processing plants, EIA pipeline projects, TCEQ emissions inventory and air permits, TNRIS StratMap 2025 parcels with owner and value (statewide load in progress). Screening data; confirm with the utility. Cite "Barrio Energy GeoIntel".
